_comment: Allowlist of docker-compose services that have NO corresponding chart Deployment/StatefulSet/Job/DaemonSet — by design.

test-only._comment: Compose-only test artifacts; never deployed to K8s.

cluster-prereq._comment: Cluster-scoped operator / addon prerequisites. Operator installs out-of-band (see charts/openwhispr/examples/*.sh). Plan 09-10 (Wave 3) landed otel-collector as a chart-rendered DaemonSet (gated on observability.collector.enabled). Plan 09-09 (Wave 3) ships Traefik IngressRoute/Middleware/ServersTransport CRDs, but operator installs the Traefik chart out-of-band — see examples/traefik-values.yaml. LGTM ingest (loki/tempo/mimir/grafana/prometheus) remains a prerequisite per A3.

bundled-ai-conditional._comment: Plan 11-03b landed charts/openwhispr/templates/speaches-deployment.yaml (Deployment + Service + PVC gated on bundledAi.enabled). Parity lint DEFAULT_HELM_ARGS sets bundledAi.enabled=true so speaches now resolves as a chart resource rather than an allowlist entry. Allowlist retained as empty per-category for future bundled-AI workloads.

load-test-only._comment: docker-compose.load-test.yml horizontal-scale-out artifacts; production scale-out happens via HPA + Pooler CRD instead.

wave-deferred._comment:
Compose services whose chart Deployments land in later waves. ALL LANDED in Wave 1-2 (Phase 09):
  - postgres -> 09-04 LANDED (CNPG Cluster CR; mapped via COMPOSE_SERVICE_ALIASES.postgres=pg)
  - pgbouncer -> 09-05 LANDED (CNPG Pooler CR; mapped via COMPOSE_SERVICE_ALIASES.pgbouncer=pg-pooler)
  - valkey -> 09-05 LANDED (Bitnami sub-chart; mapped via COMPOSE_SERVICE_ALIASES.valkey=valkey-primary)
  - minio -> 09-05 LANDED (Bitnami sub-chart; ow-minio Deployment, strip release prefix)
  - api/web/worker -> 09-06 LANDED (Deployments + HPAs + PDBs)
  - litellm -> 09-07 LANDED (embedded Deployment + ConfigMap; corporate overlay sets embedded=false)
  - migrate -> 09-08 LANDED (pre-install/pre-upgrade Helm hook Job)
